europe_now.title: Russian missile strikes impact Polish airspace
europe_now.summary: A Russian missile reportedly crashed in eastern Poland. Polish authorities have blamed Moscow for the incident.

europe_now.title: Massive migrant influx in Ceuta
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of migrants have entered the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco. Spanish authorities have deployed military personnel to manage the situation.

top_stories.title: European Wildfire Crisis
top_stories.summary: Wildfires are causing mass evacuations across several European regions. Authorities in Spain, France, and the UK warn that these megafires threaten local ways of life.

top_stories.title: EU Technological Autonomy Initiatives
top_stories.summary: The European Union is moving to co-fund seven new AI gigafactories. This investment aims to boost the continent's technological autonomy.
